cmdAddons: Addon plan and feature usage for this business (upgrade/downgrade change billing)
cmdAddonsCancelDowngrade: Cancel a scheduled downgrade and stay on the current plan
cmdAddonsDowngrade: Move this business to a lower addon plan (takes effect next billing cycle)
cmdAddonsList: Show the current addon plan, subscribable plans and feature usage
cmdAddonsUpgrade: Move this business to a higher addon plan (changes billing)
cmdBankAdd: Add a bank account. Pick the bank + enter details interactively, then verify via OTP before adding.
cmdCommsList: List notification topics and their channel preferences
cmdCustomBranding: Custom branding for the checkout page (theme colour)
cmdCustomBrandingGet: Get the checkout page theme colour for this business
cmdCustomBrandingReset: Reset the checkout page theme colour to the default
cmdCustomBrandingSet: Set the checkout page theme colour
cmdCustomSms: Custom SMS sender name for this business
cmdCustomSmsDelete: Delete the custom SMS sender name for this business
cmdCustomSmsList: Show the custom SMS sender name for this business
cmdCustomSmsSet: Set (or rename) the custom SMS sender name for this business
cmdDelete: Send a DELETE request (prompts for confirmation)
cmdDirectDebitSetup: Set up the direct-debit mandate for platform fees (bank + billing details, then confirm the mandate)
cmdDirectDebitStatus: Show the direct-debit mandate status for platform fees
cmdGet: Send a GET request  (-d key=val for path/query params)
cmdKybCardLink: Open card signup in the browser for an already-KYB'd merchant
cmdKybLink: Open KYB verification in the browser
cmdKybStatus: Get the KYB verification status for this business
cmdPost: Send a POST request  (-d key=val builds body; --data @file|-  for raw JSON)
cmdRolesAdd: Add a new custom role for this business
cmdRolesList: List available roles for this business
cmdStaffAdd: Add a staff member to this business (prompts for missing fields on a TTY)
cmdStaffDelete: Delete a staff member's access to this business
cmdStaffInvite: Invite a new staff member to this business (same as `staff add`)
cmdStaffList: List staff members for this business
cmdStaffUpdate: Update a staff member's details, role and permitted stores
